title: DataSubjectRequestForm
wrapsNative: VStack of MonarchRadioCardGroup, a segmented Picker in a MonarchFormField, MonarchTextFields, MonarchCountrySelect, a vertical TextField in a MonarchFormField, a Toggle with .monarchCheckbox and a primary MonarchButton, replaced by a success MonarchBanner
summary: A recipe, not a component: a privacy request form (get a copy, delete, correct, object, opt out) for the person the data is about or their authorised agent, with validation on send and a reference on success.
whenToUse: On a privacy or help screen where people exercise their data rights (GDPR, CCPA and similar laws) and the request goes to the company's privacy team.
whenNotToUse: For the signed-in person downloading their own data, use MonarchDataExportRequest. For deleting their own account, use the delete-account-flow recipe. For consent choices, use MonarchConsentPreferences.
api: MonarchRadioCardGroup("What would you like to do?", selection: $type, options: [MonarchRadioCardOption("access", title:, description:), …])
MonarchFormField("Who is this request for?") { Picker(…).pickerStyle(.segmented) }
MonarchCountrySelect("Country or region where the person lives", selection: $country, error:, isRequired: true)
MonarchFormField("Details", helper:, error:, isRequired:) { TextField("Details", text: $details, axis: .vertical) }
Toggle("The information I gave is accurate", isOn: $isAccurate).toggleStyle(.monarchCheckbox)
MonarchButton("Send request", variant: .primary, isLoading: isSending, fullWidth: true)

states.name: empty
states.description: Nothing chosen; errors are not shown until the first send.

states.name: agent
states.description: Choosing Someone I act for renames the person's fields and adds the agent's own name.

states.name: invalid
states.description: After Send, each missing or wrong answer shows its error with an icon, and the problem count is announced.

states.name: received
states.description: The form is replaced by a success banner with the reference.

appearance: Monarch's radio cards, text fields, country select, checkbox and primary button on the page background; errors use the danger roles with an icon, and the confirmation is a success banner. Every colour is a theme role, so dark and high-contrast themes follow.
platformNotes: The web DataSubjectRequestForm is one component with default request types, an error summary that links to each field, a verification note, a response time note and translatable messages. On iOS it is a recipe built from Monarch fields: the request types are the app's MonarchRadioCardOptions (which types apply where is for the product's legal team), the relationship is a segmented Picker, the country is MonarchCountrySelect with Foundation's names, and the submission is the app's call. There is no error summary with links; each field shows and announces its own error. Android composes the same recipe.
accessibility: Every field has a visible label read by VoiceOver; required fields add Required to their hint.
Errors appear only after Send, each with an icon and text, and Monarch fields announce a new error.
The radio cards read their title and description and mark the choice with the selected trait.
The acknowledgement is a real Toggle with the checkbox style, read as a checkbox with its state.
edgeCases: Details become required for a correction, since the team needs to know what to fix.
Keep everything typed when the send fails, and show the failure with MonarchInlineNotice above the button.
Prefill the email of a signed-in person, but let them change it.
Long request descriptions wrap in the cards at every text size.
